message.content: where did the comparables research land?

content.text:
The comparables research is done and written up at `~/links-eval/comparables.md`: twenty-five sources, none of which checks whether a link's target is what the sentence says it is, which is the gap this plugin's links-resolve check fills on the cheap side and links-judge on the expensive side.

The measured cost on this machine is under ten milliseconds per stop for two hundred links, so the check is on by default.

## Closing ask

Approve turning links-judge on for your own profile.
